source: Approved S14 secure Init flags and closed JWKS/cache prerequisites
review: Isolated enabled ignoreJwtExpiry with valid multimap, supported target and cache/JWKS test prerequisites. Java accepts Init and forwards token-free request exactly; authored Rust InvalidConfiguration at Init, zero dispatch/fetches. Does not claim Java JWT verification on token-free input. No token input for logJwtToken case; no secret logging assertion is inferred. Other insecure flags false; explicit insecure-test override absent. Init/bootstrap fetches now asserted separately from per-request fetches. Failed-refresh cooldown fixture explicitly disables bootstrap so first request establishes the failed attempt, rather than inheriting Init cooldown. Prior revisions retained.
remainingContractAssertions: Explicit insecure-test override and no-secret logging across failure/verification outcomes
